yesterday I posted my best performing video in 2+ years 😁

in the past 24 hours this video hit:
➡️ 260,000 views
➡️ 2,200 likes
➡️ 1,500 new followers

for over 2 years I stuck to my niche, didn't give up when times got tough, and continued making unique video content

this is the beginning of the next leg up in my career as a creator in Web3

I couldn't have done it without all of you, so thank you for showing love here 💜
